description: Analysis plan only (not launched), fixed in the Phase 5 Comparison Plan 2026-11-09T11:00+01:00 before any degree-feature run: combines the Phase 3 synthetic sweep (outdir/sweep_synthetic) with the Phase 5 degree control (outdir/sweep_synthetic_degree), all on reproduced-papers-1. Amended 2026-11-09T11:13+01:00 (technical, after the degree result): added synthetic_quantum_top3 because the summariser requires every run in the sweep folders to be in the plan; the decision rule is unchanged.
split: test (10% of the 800 generated graphs, split seed 1729)
selection_rule: none: fixed configurations. The C3 quantum advantage survives the degree control if synthetic_quantum is better than synthetic_degree under the tie rule; a tie or a degree win means a trivial classical feature recovers it at identical capacity.
checkpoint_rule: model with the highest validation accuracy over the 200 epochs, evaluated once on the test split
aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over the four seeds
tie_rule: no winner unless the margin exceeds twice the larger seed standard deviation and an exact McNemar test on the pooled test predictions gives p < 0.05
